testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-017 EDG-007 SAN-008 SAN-012: Admin sees the page without the Questionnaire

scenario.summary: The tester's own Admin account, signed in directly on the storefront without Shop As, redeems a size from inventory and sees Address and Contact, Delivery, Order Summary and Place Order without the Questionnaire and without prices. The Super Admin halves of SAN-017 and EDG-007 are held until a Super Admin account exists (partially automated).
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
Open the Header Cart; if the own Admin account's cart has lines, remove them so it starts empty
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown as the Admin (no Shop As)
Enter quantity 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 (within inventory) and click Redeem Now (SAN-008, SAN-017 step 1)
Check the sections: Address and Contact, Delivery, Order Summary and Place Order shown, Questionnaire not shown (SAN-017 steps 2-3, EDG-007 steps 2-3, SAN-008)
Check that no price, subtotal, tax, shipping cost or total is shown (SAN-012 step 5)
Click Cart in the Header; check the same page and sections (EDG-007 step 1)
Remove the line so the own Admin account's cart is empty again
stateChanges: A cart line on the tester's own Admin account, removed again by the test
A session for the tester's own Admin account
assertions: For the Admin: Address and Contact, Delivery, Order Summary and Place Order are shown
For the Admin the Questionnaire section is not shown
For the Admin no unit price, line price, subtotal, tax, shipping cost, total or currency amount is shown
Header Cart opens the same combined page for the Admin
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-017, EDG-007, SAN-008, SAN-012 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size
Admins redeem from inventory, not from an allotment (SAN-008): the product key ensures variant inventory >= 1; no allotment need
SAN-017 / EDG-007 Admin halves use the own Admin account directly, without Shop As, as the cases say

Held (partially automated): the Super Admin halves of SAN-017 (step 4) and EDG-007 (step 4) wait for a Super Admin account, like BMP-36 TC2. Shop As exists only for Sales Reps and Market Coordinators and created users have no password, so a created Super Admin or Web Admin cannot be reached (user answer 2026-11-27, analysis section 11)
The own Admin account is shared: its cart is emptied at the start and at the end so runs do not affect each other; parallel runs with the same account would collide

Not covered (test author report on the spec (framework branch dev_BMP94, 75b25168, 2026-11-27)): the Super Admin halves of SAN-017 and EDG-007 are held until a Super Admin account exists (analysis section 11); only the Admin half with the tester's own account is automated - partially automated

qa finding (2026-11-27): the Header Cart opens a cart drawer; its Checkout link opens the combined page. Defect against SAN-011 (user, 2026-11-27; config/known-failures.yaml): the Header Cart should open the combined page directly. T2 soft-checks the direct open (fails on qa) and then goes on through the drawer, as the other tests do
qa finding (2026-11-27): the section headings on qa are lowercase "Address and contact" and "Order summary"; the test compares the FRD texts "Address and Contact" / "Order Summary" case-insensitively
